page.overview:
Who is Cortex?

In Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, Cortex is a Battle Nexus competitor.

Cortex is a Yōkai with big brain. He also has a purple color and eyes and has a beard.

Cortex is relatively stoic and serious, until he becomes impatient. He is also said to be highly sadistic by Big Mama.

Cortex debuted in "Battle Nexus: New York". He opposed the Battle Nexus Wizbang team Donatello and Hypno-Potamus in a game of chess. If Cortex won the game, he would keep Donnie as a game piece to add to his collection. In the beginning of the match, Donnie was transformed into a set of chess pieces and Cortex awaited Hypno's first move. However, due to Hypno's lack of experience playing chess, he greatly hesitated to make his first move, leading Cortex to eventually lose his patience and strike the table. Consequently, Cortex's king piece fell over and he automatically lost the match to his opponents, as this accidental action of "slaying his own king" as Donnie put it meant that he had technically surrendered.
